output.population: 522 middle-aged, overweight subjects with impaired glucose tolerance (mean age 55 years; mean BMI 31).
output.intervention: Individualized lifestyle counseling to reduce weight, total fat and saturated fat intake and increase fiber intake and physical activity.
output.outcome: Incident type 2 diabetes confirmed by a second oral glucose-tolerance test; body-weight change was also measured.
output.effect: Cumulative diabetes incidence after 4 years was 11% (95% CI 6% to 15%) in the intervention group versus 23% (95% CI 17% to 29%) in controls; diabetes risk was reduced by 58% during the trial (P<0.001). Mean follow-up was 3.2 years.
output.applicability_boundary: Applies to middle-aged, overweight people with impaired glucose tolerance at high risk for type 2 diabetes; the source does not establish effects in normoglycemic or already diabetic populations.
output.source_span: The cumulative incidence of diabetes after four years was 11 percent in the intervention group and 23 percent in the control group.
